args: const result=[];for(const c of (await eda.sch_PrimitiveComponent.getAll()).filter(c=>c.getState_SupplierId())){const pins=await eda.sch_PrimitiveComponent.getAllPinsByPrimitiveId(c.getState_PrimitiveId());result.push({id:c.getState_PrimitiveId(),ref:c.getState_Designator(),mpn:c.getState_ManufacturerId(),lcsc:c.getState_SupplierId(),addBom:c.getState_AddIntoBom(),addPcb:c.getState_AddIntoPcb(),pins:(pins||[]).map(p=>({number:p.getState_PinNumber(),name:p.getState_PinName(),x:p.getState_X(),y:p.getState_Y()}))});}const test=await eda.sch_ManufactureData.getBomFile('keyparts-bool-filter','csv',undefined,[{property:'Add into BOM',includeValue:true}]);return {parts:result,booleanFilteredBytes:test?.size};
